billingInterpretation: Current standard-runner compute in this public repository has no billable minutes. Rounded-minute figures below are a planning proxy for comparable private-repository usage, not an invoice.
method: Jobs API started_at to completed_at, excluding skipped/unstarted jobs; round each started job up separately only for the private-repository proxy. Sample covers all 26 push workflows on Nov 2-4 present in the latest 100 runs; all attempts are 1. 24 were operational Publish/Update commits; 2 were the code merge.

threeOrdinaryPublishes.estimateCondition: Keep one test job and an independent one-job Pages workflow, with each consolidated job below 60 seconds. Estimate; not deployed or benchmarked.

recommendations.action: Move advisory tests and their warning summary into the safety job; retain advisory continue-on-error, preserve safety failures.
recommendations.effect: Eliminate one runner start per test workflow.

recommendations.action: Combine Pages artifact preparation/upload/deploy into one job, as EXPO already does; keep independent from CI and preserve allowlist.
recommendations.effect: Eliminate one runner start per deployment.

recommendations.action: Publish each logical operation's sidecars and generated artifacts together through the existing atomic publisher; coalesce redundant sends.
recommendations.effect: Reduce push-triggered workflows and intermediate inconsistent states; requires app change and transaction tests.

recommendations.action: Recognize unchanged content before making a new commit, with coherent revision timestamps and downstream freshness semantics retained.
recommendations.effect: Avoid timestamp-only commits; still recover undelivered data.

recommendations.action: After removing historical locks, use operational invariant/contract checks for data-only pushes and the full suite for code/test/workflow changes.
recommendations.effect: Reduce actual test seconds; little rounded-minute benefit while both variants already finish below one minute.

cautions: Do not use blanket skip-ci tags on operational commits; they can suppress the push-triggered Pages workflow.
Do not exclude menu/routing/swap JSON from all checks.
Do not make deployments depend on historical-menu tests.
Do not add a runner job just to classify paths or sleep for a debounce.
Do not invoke the full EXPO suite for every DOOR publish; use focused contract probes.
Keep existing cancellation/path filters; batching reduces work before runner allocation.
Treat Page-delivery timeouts with bounded recovery and delivery receipts; lowering timeout alone is not a proven flow improvement.
